content:
# Micah 7 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 7:1 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | Woe to-me! For I-have-become like-gatherings-of summer-fruit, like-gleanings-of the-vintage; there-is-no cluster to-eat — no-early-fig my-soul desires. |
| LOGOS | Woe is me! For I have become as when the summer fruit has been gathered, as when the grapes have been gleaned: there is no cluster to eat, no first-ripe fig that my soul desires. |
| PNEUMA | How miserable I am! I feel like a fruit picker after the harvest — there's nothing left to eat. Not a single grape or early fig to satisfy my hunger. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 7:5 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | Do-not-trust in-a-neighbor; do-not-rely on-a-friend; from-her-who-lies in-your-bosom guard the-doors-of your-mouth. |
| LOGOS | Put no trust in a neighbor; have no confidence in a friend; guard the doors of your mouth from her who lies in your arms; |
| PNEUMA | Don't trust your neighbor. Don't confide in your friend. Even be careful what you say to your wife. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 7:7 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | But-I — in-YHWH I-will-watch; I-will-wait for-the-God-of my-salvation; my-God will-hear-me. |
| LOGOS | But as for me, I will look to the LORD; I will wait for the God of my salvation; my God will hear me. |
| PNEUMA | But as for me — I will look to the LORD for help. I will wait confidently for God to save me, and my God will hear me. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 7:8 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | Do-not-rejoice against-me, my-enemy! Though I-have-fallen, I-will-arise; though I-sit in-darkness, YHWH [is] a-light for-me. |
| LOGOS | Rejoice not over me, O my enemy; when I fall, I shall rise; when I sit in darkness, the LORD will be a light to me. |
| PNEUMA | Don't gloat over me, my enemies! Though I have fallen, I will get back up. Though I sit in the darkness, the LORD will be my light. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 7:13 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-the-earth will-be a-desolation because-of her-inhabitants, from-the-fruit-of their-deeds. |
| LOGOS | But the earth will be desolate because of its inhabitants, for the fruit of their deeds. |
| PNEUMA | But first the rest of the earth will become desolate because of the evil its inhabitants have done. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 7:19 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | He-will-again have-compassion-on-us; He-will-tread-down our-iniquities; and-You-will-cast into-the-depths-of the-sea all their-sins. |
| LOGOS | He will again have compassion on us; He will tread our iniquities underfoot. You will cast all our sins into the depths of the sea. |
| PNEUMA | Once again You will have compassion on us. You will trample our sins under Your feet and throw them into the depths of the ocean! |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---
